·
Key determinant of preload hence cardiac
  output

·
Diaphragm relaxation: loss of negative intrathoracic pressure
  -> ↓VR -> ↓LAP

·
RV output: e.g. primary RV failure -> ↓LA filling -> ↓LAP

·
Intrathoracic pressure: e.g. PPV -> obstruction to LA filling
  -> ↓LAP

·
Intrapericardial pressure: e.g. tamponade -> obstruction to LA
  filling -> ↓LAP

·
Mitral valve function: e.g. mitral stenosis -> ↓emptying ->
  ↑LAP

·
LV stiffness: LV hypertrophy, fibrosis, infiltration ->
  ↓compliance ->↑LAP
